Why Musko Exists: Zero-Risk Land Ownership in Gwagwalada

In Abuja and satellite expansion corridors like Gwagwalada, thousands of hardworking civil servants, doctors, university professors, and diaspora Nigerians have fallen victim to unapproved layouts, double allocations, or land encroached by local customary claimants.

CEO Mustapha took an uncompromising stance. Before a single plot in our Gwagwalada layouts is offered to any buyer, our team physically surveys the coordinates with RTK satellite GPS, verifies title records with AGIS and the Gwagwalada Area Council, casts permanent concrete perimeter beacons, and secures complete legal indemnity.

“In Abuja real estate, paperwork is only valid when verified against the master-plan at AGIS and anchored by concrete beacons in the soil. We do not gamble with our clients’ hard-earned money.”

— Mustapha, Founder & CEO, Musko Properties

FCT Diligence Engine

Our 5-Stage Gwagwalada Verification Protocol

How our executive leadership and licensed surveyors ensure absolute legal security for every plot before public offering.

01

AGIS Cadastral Charting

Coordinate charting against Abuja Masterplan and FCDA acquisition boundaries to guarantee zero encroachment on public utilities.

FCT Certified
02

Area Council Validation

Forensic title search at the Gwagwalada Area Council Land Department to confirm root of title and official allocation gazette.

FCT Certified
03

Soil & Topography Test

Civil engineers test soil bearing capacity, verifying 100% dry savannah table land with zero flood vulnerability near River Usuma basin.

FCT Certified
04

GPS Beacon Implantation

SURCON registered surveyors implant permanent concrete boundary pegs tied into the National Geodetic Grid.

FCT Certified
05

Deed Delivery & Allocation

Execution of Deed of Assignment, Contract of Sale, and doorstep international DHL delivery of registered documents worldwide.

FCT Certified
